correctness.rationale: The assigned shell argument is correct: for the logarithmic weight, the \(m\)-th radial moment concentrates between the two adjacent saddle boundaries, so a shell symbol taking value \(c_m\) there has eigenvalue \(c_m+o(1)\). Since each homogeneous block is finite dimensional, a diagonal error is compact exactly when its scalar sequence tends to zero. Thus every class in \(\ell^\infty/c_0\) is represented modulo compacts.
